title: July
author: Cooper T.
desc: Blast though sticking points and experience the joy of lifting! Designed specifically for bench press development, arm, leg, and back training is not included. Be sure to include these muscle groups on your own, but don’t fatigue yourself too much in order to not interfere with bench press. Meant to be added onto the end of long peaking cycles or as a transitory block, not intended for beginner lifters.

ex.note: Practice for singles on bench press, treat it like a max and focus carefully, look for potential weaknesses in technique or muscles in the movement, focus on cues and note their effectiveness.
Go heavy and hard!
Perform on a bench, go decently heavy and focus on the squeeze at the top, explode from the bottom and fight your way through to maximize performance.
Make sure these are slow and controlled to maximize the mind muscle connection with the shoulders, use this time to work out any shoulder imbalances if necessary.
Explosive; perform with speed but don’t gas yourself, it’s a PAP (post-activation potentiation), so it can be supersetted with the Pin Press.
Fairly intuitive, and push for as much weight as possible, start from the top and lower to pins an inch or two *below* the sticking point.
Identify the sticking point on the bench press and pause the bar just below it during this Spoto Press. Go heavy and grind for it.
Skull crushers with the EZ bar, go heavy, alternative is a JM press.
Main lift, push and progress this exercise intently. Pause for 3-4 seconds, stay tight and maximize weight without form breakdown, explode off the chest.
Pause at the bottom and push for heavy weight.
This can also be performed in a bench if available with cables, replicating the bench press conditions more optimally. Either way, maximize intent and get high quality reps in.
Perform with a bodybuilding style; control the weight and stick to the rep range for optimal tricep hypertrophy.
